notes: Adds Internet Tycoon (place 10767564282) as its own shelf: modules/tycoon.lua and pages/tycoon.lua, wired into the loader's place table, the forced-profile allowlist and the Games list. Two features. Money finds the balance where a tycoon keeps it (leaderstats, a folder on the player, a player attribute), puts the real value in an editable box, writes it, reads it back, and can keep re-applying it every 0.35s - the only part of a server-reconciled number a client can hold. Thunderstorms find every weather/storm/thunder/rain value or attribute visible on Lighting, the player, workspace and ReplicatedStorage, pin them to calm once a second while on, and switch off running lightning and thunder effects (Enabled = false, saved and restored, never deleted).
